traveloptics.fading_mage:dialogue_11: I began to learn. Alone. In silence.   §6[Right-Click]
traveloptics.fading_mage:dialogue_12: I tried to prove it could come back.   §6[Right-Click]
traveloptics.fading_mage:dialogue_13: Magic had cost. But so did silence!   §6[Right-Click]
traveloptics.fading_mage:dialogue_16: What was taken cannot be replaced.   §6[Right-Click]
traveloptics.fading_mage:dialogue_17: But maybe... someone else can find what I couldn’t...   §6[Right-Click]
traveloptics.fading_mage:dialogue_2: Not because magic faded… but because they were told it had.   §6[Right-Click]
traveloptics.fading_mage:dialogue_4: A world run by metal and logic leaves no room for dreams.   §6[Right-Click]
traveloptics.fading_mage:dialogue_6: They laughed when I said magic was still here.   §6[Right-Click]
traveloptics.fading_mage:dialogue_7: Some truths aren’t forgotten... they’re buried.   §6[Right-Click]
